name: Kanoya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kanoya city emblem in blue, red and yellow: a blue square-like device bearing a red disc with a yellow stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kanoya, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 May 2006.

features.role: Kanoya city emblem — a blue square-like device bearing a red disc with a yellow stylised character
